outcome: Proportion of patients receiving LMWH prophylaxis
Proportion of patients receiving weight-adjusted LMWH doses
cohort: 108 obese (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2) postpartum women at an Australian tertiary referral hospital
finding: VTE prophylaxis practices with LMWH in obese postpartum patients varied, with inconsistencies in weight-adjusted dosing and extended-course prescribing.
